cards.headline: Trump says US will end $4 billion in military aid to Israel
cards.summary: On Election Day Trump said US military aid to Israel will end at year's end. He said Netanyahu raised the idea and that Israel can still buy US weapons. Former Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene said it shows how bad the polling is.
cards.why_it_matters: The roughly $4 billion annual aid is a pillar of the US-Israel alliance, and the move would shift US policy in the Middle East.

sources.title: Trump claims US will end military aid to Israel by end of this year
Trump says Israel will stop receiving $4B in US aid by year's end, can still buy weapons
Greene: Trump’s Israel aid announcement shows ‘how bad the polling is’

cards.headline: First polls close as control of Congress is decided
cards.summary: Polls began closing in Indiana and Kentucky as voters decide House and Senate control. Forecasts favored Democratic gains, while White House officials projected optimism. Early counts may look redder than final results and control could take days to settle.
cards.why_it_matters: The result sets the balance of power for Trump's last two years, shaping spending, oversight and legislation.

sources.title: First election night polls close with Trump in battle mode
First polls close in high-stakes vote for control of US Congress
White House ‘projecting optimism’ as polls close, but Trump aides sweat it out behind closed doors

cards.headline: Voting machine and weather problems reported on Election Day
cards.summary: Westchester County, New York, machines rejected paper ballots, which will still be counted. Flooding moved polling places in seven Florida counties, and some North Carolina results were delayed an hour. Officials describe most technical issues as minor.
cards.why_it_matters: Delays could slow results in close House races, including one in New York.

sources.title: Voting machine chaos hits key House battleground
Paper ballots in NY county unable to be accepted by voting machines, will still be counted
Where have there been technical issues so far during US midterm elections?

cards.headline: Trump tells FT US has no immediate plan to strike Iran
cards.summary: Trump told the Financial Times the US has no immediate plan to strike Iran and called his position with Tehran brilliant. Oil edged higher after a two-day decline as traders weighed conflicting signals on peace talks.
cards.why_it_matters: Signals on Iran move oil and gasoline prices and affect the risk of renewed war.

sources.title: US has no immediate plan to strike Iran, Trump tells FT
Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 4

cards.headline: Supreme Court appears to favor Catholic preschools in Colorado case
cards.summary: At argument, the court's conservative majority signaled support for Catholic preschools seeking to join Colorado's universal pre-K without admitting same-sex-parent families. Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson said the schools want a special rule to discriminate.
cards.why_it_matters: The ruling could set how religious freedom and anti-discrimination law apply to publicly funded programs nationwide.

sources.title: Supreme Court leans toward LGBTQ exclusion for publicly funded Catholic preschools
Supreme Court offers support for Catholic preschools challenging state funding requirements
Ketanji Brown Jackson accuses Catholic preschools of wanting ‘special rule’ to bar LGBT families in universal preschool case

cards.headline: DOJ sends target letters to Democrats over decoy Dan Sullivan
cards.summary: The Justice Department is reportedly sending target letters to about 20 Democrats, including lawyer Marc Elias, over an alleged effort to recruit a second Dan Sullivan to Alaska's Senate race. Democrats have denied involvement in related reporting.
cards.why_it_matters: A criminal probe touching a Senate race on election day raises questions about prosecutors' role in elections.

sources.title: DOJ sends target letters to Marc Elias and other Democrats over decoy Dan Sullivan candidacy

cards.headline: Haley Stevens asks for marshals' protection after threats
cards.summary: Rep. Haley Stevens requested US marshals' protection after telling authorities she received death threats following her endorsement of Republican Mike Rogers, two Trump administration officials told Axios.
cards.why_it_matters: Threats against officials over political choices are a growing concern on Election Day.

sources.title: Haley Stevens requests U.S. marshals' protection after death threats
Michigan voters split between party loyalty and Senate candidates in closely watched race

cards.headline: Texas Senate race becomes most expensive in US history
cards.summary: Spending in the Paxton-Talarico Senate race hit $573.2 million, a record, as Texans voted.
cards.why_it_matters: The spending shows how much a single Senate seat may matter for control of the chamber.

sources.title: Texans vote in most expensive Senate race in US history

cards.headline: Trump-backed Gallrein wins Massie's Kentucky House seat
cards.summary: Decision Desk HQ projected Republican Ed Gallrein, endorsed by Trump, defeated Democrat in Kentucky's 4th District, a seat held by Trump critic Rep. Thomas Massie.
cards.why_it_matters: An early read on how Trump's endorsement performed in a seat held by one of his Republican critics.

sources.title: Trump-backed Kentucky Republican wins Massie House seat

cards.headline: Russian strikes on Ukraine kill at least 38 in 24 hours
cards.summary: At least 38 people died in 24 hours after Russia hit an aid centre, hospice and hospital, and Zelenskyy warned dozens more may be trapped. He said the barrage coincided with US elections and will affect the war.
cards.why_it_matters: Heavy civilian losses come days before US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi.

sources.title: Death toll rises in Ukraine after Russia attacks aid centre, hospice and hospital
Death toll hits 29 after Russian strike on Ukrainian aid site, with 48 still missing

cards.headline: Air Force seeks mass-produced cruise missile for Ukraine
cards.summary: The US Air Force asked contractors to mass produce the Extended Range Attack Munition for Ukraine.
cards.why_it_matters: It signals continued US weapons supply to Ukraine and a deeper industrial commitment.

sources.title: US Air Force asks industry for new cruise missile for Ukraine

cards.headline: Binance says hackers used fake job interviews and an AI tool
cards.summary: Binance's postmortem says an engineer was lured through a fake job interview and a tampered installer, with suspected North Korean attackers stealing $6.3 billion. The exchange says it has replenished 98% of affected assets.
cards.why_it_matters: The breach shows how social engineering can defeat major crypto custodians holding customer funds.

sources.title: Binance says fake job interviews used as part of $6.3bn crypto hack
Binance co-CEO Richard Teng says hackers used fake job interviews, AI tool to steal $6.3 billion in crypto
Binance Says Hackers Used Well-Known Tricks to Carry Out a $6.34 Billion Heist

cards.headline: Apple falls as memory costs hurt margin outlook in Ternus debut
cards.summary: Apple shares fell nearly 2% after CEO John Ternus's first earnings report. The company's gross margin forecast disappointed investors amid high memory costs, and services revenue growth slowed.
cards.why_it_matters: Component costs may push up device prices and weigh on a major holding in many retirement accounts.

sources.title: Apple stock sinks as global memory crisis hurts profits, giving Ternus his first big test
What analysts are telling us while Apple’s stock falls after earnings report

cards.headline: AMD jumps 8% as data center revenue nearly doubles
cards.summary: AMD reported better-than-expected third-quarter results driven by booming AI chip sales. Super Micro also rose on a strong AI server outlook.
cards.why_it_matters: Strong chip demand counters worries that the AI spending boom is fading.

sources.title: AMD stock jumps 8% on earnings as data center revenue nearly doubles
Super Micro’s stock pops as earnings show booming demand for AI servers

cards.headline: Meta seeks up to $25 billion in bond sale for AI
cards.summary: Meta aims to raise $20 billion to $25 billion in debt as it ramps up spending on AI infrastructure, models and services.
cards.why_it_matters: Heavy borrowing by tech giants is central to worries about AI debt and market stability.

sources.title: Meta seeks to raise up to $25 billion in debt sale as AI spending jumps

cards.headline: Job openings rise to 7.52 million in September
cards.summary: The BLS reported job openings rose by 333,000 to 7.52 million, well above the 7.15 million consensus, ahead of the payrolls report.
cards.why_it_matters: A firmer labor market could keep the Fed leaning toward more rate hikes.

sources.title: Job openings posted big September gain in positive sign for labor market ahead of payrolls report
Dollar Rises Most in a Month on Higher US Yields, Strong Data

cards.headline: CVS Health moves to dismantle its $117 billion empire
cards.summary: The FT reports CVS is moving to break up its healthcare business, including a potential spin-off of its drugstore business, as political pressure grows on pharmacy benefit managers and insurers.
cards.why_it_matters: A breakup could reshape how Americans get pharmacy care and insurance.

sources.title: CVS Health moves to dismantle $117bn healthcare empire

cards.headline: CrowdStrike launches AI kill switch and buys two startups
cards.summary: CrowdStrike launched a tool it says can stop rogue internal AI agents, block relaunches and cut network access. It will also buy Fiddler AI and Dreadnode for nearly $500 million.
cards.why_it_matters: Companies are racing to control autonomous AI agents as they gain access to corporate systems.

sources.title: CrowdStrike launches AI kill switch that it says can stop internal agents that go rogue
CrowdStrike to shell out nearly $500M for 2 AI security startups as the market for securing agents takes off

cards.headline: Apple opens Siri AI to third-party apps in iOS 27.3
cards.summary: Apple said developers can integrate Siri AI's features in all apps, letting the assistant draw on personal context and act across apps, as iOS 27.3 rolls out.
cards.why_it_matters: It changes how iPhone users can control apps by voice.

sources.title: Apple starts giving Siri AI access to third-party apps

cards.headline: Fal doubles valuation to $16 billion with $1.3 billion round
cards.summary: AI inference startup Fal raised $1.3 billion in a round led by Bessemer, doubling its valuation as demand surges.
cards.why_it_matters: Investors keep funding AI infrastructure despite public-market jitters.

sources.title: AI inference startup Fal doubles its valuation to $16B as demand surges

cards.headline: Geoffrey Hinton says humans might have been better off without AI
cards.summary: The Nobel-winning AI researcher warned the technology could be near to triggering a major incident such as a power or banking shutdown, and said we might have been better off without it.
cards.why_it_matters: A leading pioneer's warning feeds the debate over AI safety rules.

sources.title: AI ‘godfather’ Geoffrey Hinton: it might turn out we were better off without AI

cards.headline: Seven European flights hit by bomb threats, all false alarms
cards.summary: Planes in Poland, Spain, Bulgaria and Italy were searched or diverted after threats, including on Ryanair and Wizz Air routes. Officials called them hoaxes; it is unclear whether they were coordinated.
cards.why_it_matters: The hoaxes disrupted travel and raise security questions across Europe.

sources.title: Seven flights across Europe targeted by suspected bomb threats
Seven planes across Europe searched or diverted after ‘malicious hoax’ bomb threats

cards.headline: Freezer hacks spread to UK food suppliers
cards.summary: UK food suppliers were hit by cyberattacks after hackers raised the temperature of supermarket freezers across Europe. The NCSC said national impact is minimal but it may be the start of a wider threat.
cards.why_it_matters: Attacks on industrial controls threaten food supplies and show exposure of critical infrastructure.

sources.title: Food suppliers in UK hit by cyber-attacks after freezers targeted in Europe
Supermarket fridges hit with cyberattacks across Europe — here's what's happening

cards.headline: Spain's transport minister resigns after deadly train crash
cards.summary: Spain's transport minister resigned days after a collision south of Madrid killed at least 69 people. Two Australians and a Japanese citizen were among the latest victims identified.
cards.why_it_matters: Four Americans were among the dead, and the resignation marks the crash's political fallout.

sources.title: Spanish transport minister resigns days after deadly train crash
Two Australians confirmed dead in Spain’s high-speed train crash

cards.headline: Greenland parliament approves security deal with US, Denmark
cards.summary: Greenland's parliament voted 16-0, with seven abstentions, for a trilateral security agreement with the US and Denmark signed in September.
cards.why_it_matters: It settles a key Arctic security arrangement for the US and its NATO ally.

sources.title: Greenland parliament approves security deal with US, Denmark

cards.headline: UK and EU agree draft deal to cut food export red tape
cards.summary: The draft food deal, ahead of a UK-EU summit later this month, is the most significant part of the so-called Brexit reset agreed so far. The Guardian reports Andy Burnham will announce more EU trade deals.
cards.why_it_matters: It affects trade with a major US ally and partner.

sources.title: UK and EU agree draft deal to scrap Brexit red tape over food exports
Andy Burnham to unveil EU trade deals worth billions of pounds

cards.headline: King Charles expresses sorrow over slavery as reparations calls grow
cards.summary: Speaking in Antigua at a Commonwealth summit, King Charles said he wanted to address past wrongs but stopped short of an apology or explicit support for reparations. Caribbean leaders are calling for reparations.
cards.why_it_matters: The debate over colonial-era reparations is a continuing diplomatic issue for Britain.

sources.title: King Charles addresses summit as demands for slavery apology grow
UK’s King Charles expresses ‘sorrow’ in Antigua over slave trade

cards.headline: Venezuela moves to unwind hate speech law used to jail dissidents
cards.summary: Venezuelan lawmakers took a first step toward reforming a law long used to jail dissidents, as the interim government unwinds tools of repression from ousted leader Nicolás Maduro's era.
cards.why_it_matters: It is a sign of political change in a major US-focused Latin American crisis.

sources.title: Venezuela Moves to Unwind Hate Speech Law That Jailed Thousands

cards.headline: Pentagon begins following Ukraine into wider ground-robot use
cards.summary: Defense One reports the Pentagon is starting to adopt ground robots more widely, following Ukraine, though many US unmanned ground vehicles are more complicated than the cheap, expendable ones Kyiv buys.
cards.why_it_matters: Battlefield lessons from Ukraine are shaping how the US military buys and fields robots.

sources.title: Pentagon is beginning to follow Ukraine into wider use of ground robots

cards.headline: Canva cuts or changes roles for 22 percent of staff
cards.summary: Canva said changes affect 1,271 people, 22 percent of its staff, including role changes, relocation to hubs and layoffs.

sources.title: Canva is announcing changes and layoffs affecting 22 percent of its staff

cards.headline: NTSB says Learjet parts fell off before Florida crash
cards.summary: The NTSB said key parts were found three miles from the crash site, indicating the business jet partially broke apart in the air before a nosedive on Sunday near Palm Beach.
cards.why_it_matters: It points investigators toward an in-flight structural failure.

cards.headline: Another child dies of measles as CDC reportedly holds up alert
cards.summary: Ars Technica reports another child has died of measles, with the CDC reportedly holding up a health alert. New York's governor pointed to Health Secretary Kennedy's anti-vaccine work as spurring outbreaks.
cards.why_it_matters: Measles deaths are returning in the US, with a dispute over federal response.

sources.title: Another child dies of measles as CDC reportedly holds up health alert

cards.headline: Trump signs proclamations on space freedom and anti-communism
cards.summary: Trump signed the American Declaration of Freedom in Space, which says the solar system and outer space are open to exploration, development and use, plus a proclamation on anti-communism.
cards.why_it_matters: The space declaration outlines US policy on commercial and permanent presence beyond Earth.

cards.headline: Big Tech and environmental groups discuss data center framework
cards.summary: A document reviewed by The Hill shows tech firms and environmental groups in a Responsible Data Center Development Collaborative seeking a common national approach to data center development.
cards.why_it_matters: Data centers drive electricity demand and are a growing political issue.

cards.headline: Cleveland Meredith, pardoned Jan. 6 defendant, charged over threats to judges

cards.why_it_matters: Threats against judges are a continuing concern.

sources.title: Pardoned Jan. 6 defendant arrested and charged with threatening federal judges

cards.headline: Oklahoma man charged over 700 white powder mailings to officials
cards.summary: The Justice Department charged Robin Martin, arrested Monday, who investigators linked to more than 700 mailings of white powder to public figures in two waves before the midterms.
cards.why_it_matters: The mailings targeted officials during the election season.

cards.summary: Axios, citing three sources, reports former Army Lt. Gen. Brett Sylvia is under federal investigation and may face court-martial for allegedly leaking to Wall Street Journal and New York Times reporters.
cards.why_it_matters: The case concerns leak enforcement and press sources.

cards.summary: Servier reported a surprise setback for sevasemten, being tested for Becker muscular dystrophy, a form that lacks treatment, after a $1.55 billion deal.
cards.why_it_matters: Patients with Becker muscular dystrophy still have no approved therapy.

cards.headline: Palantir and Shopify fall after earnings
cards.summary: Palantir sank as analysts pointed to slowing total contract value. Shopify fell over 8% after Q3 revenue and merchandise volume missed estimates.

cards.summary: J.P. Morgan's strategist says falling below 7,500 would increase selling pressure and volatility and could lead to a correction. US stock futures climbed Tuesday as the AI trade regained momentum.

cards.summary: Google will let schools disable its AI tools, but schools that restrict AI altogether will lose access to Google Search because AI is integrated into it.

cards.headline: Indian navy rescues 20 crew from hijacked Iranian fishing boat
cards.summary: A warship, surveillance aircraft and marine commandos rescued 20 crew from an Iranian fishing boat hijacked off Somalia, amid a resurgence of piracy in the Gulf of Aden and Indian Ocean.
cards.why_it_matters: Renewed piracy threatens a key shipping route.

sources.title: Indian navy rescues 20 crew from Iranian fishing boat hijacked off Somalia

cards.headline: Vibrating mattress plus pills aids Alzheimer's protein clearance
cards.summary: A small study found lying on a vibrating mattress for 40 minutes, with two pills releasing nitric oxide, boosted clearance of an Alzheimer's-related protein through the brain's waste system.
cards.why_it_matters: Early work toward non-drug Alzheimer's approaches; not yet shown to help patients.

sources.title: Vibrating mattress helps clear Alzheimer’s protein from the brain

cards.headline: NASA's Swift Observatory to reenter atmosphere this week
cards.summary: The 3,200-pound satellite is expected to fall to Earth later this week, with a wide reentry zone covering parts of Africa, Australia, Southeast Asia and South America.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows the cost of failing orbits as NASA seeks ideas to save Hubble.
